items.title: Beyond Cosine Similarity: Taming Semantic Drift and Antonym Intrusion in a 15-Million Node Turkish Synonym Graph
items.title_zh: 超越余弦相似度：在 1500 万节点土耳其语同义词图中抑制语义漂移与反义词入侵
items.summary: The system processes 15 million Turkish lexical items and evaluates 520 million candidate relationships to produce 2.9 million high-precision semantic clusters, using a labeled set of 843,000 concept pairs built with Gemini 2.5-Flash and verified against human-curated dictionaries. A three-way relation discriminator reaches 90% macro-F1, and a topology-aware expansion-pruning procedure limits semantic drift and erroneous transitive chains while resolving polysemy.

items.title: Legal Retrieval for Public Defenders
items.title_zh: 面向公共辩护人的法律检索
items.summary: In partnership with the New Jersey Office of the Public Defender, the authors build NJ BriefBank, a retrieval tool that surfaces relevant appellate briefs, and find that existing retrieval benchmarks do not transfer to public-defense research. Adding legal query expansion, domain-specific data, and curated synthetic examples improves retrieval, and they release a query taxonomy and a manually annotated evaluation dataset.

items.title: Implementing Tensor Logic: Unifying Datalog and Neural Reasoning via Tensor Contraction
items.title_zh: 实现 Tensor Logic：通过张量收缩统一 Datalog 与神经推理
items.summary: The paper empirically validates Domingos's Tensor Logic by showing that recursive Datalog rules and iterative tensor contractions compute the same transitive closure on a 1,972-person genealogy graph, converging in 74 iterations. It also trains learnable transformation matrices for zero-shot compositional inference and reaches MRR 0.3068 on FB15k-237 link prediction and 0.3346 on a compositional reasoning benchmark.

items.title: Think Locally, Explain Globally: Graph-Guided LLM Investigations via Local Reasoning and Belief Propagation
items.title_zh: 局部思考、全局解释：基于图引导的 LLM 调查与信念传播
items.summary: EoG formulates open-ended investigation as abductive reasoning over a dependency graph, with an LLM performing bounded local evidence mining and cause-versus-symptom labeling while a deterministic controller manages traversal, state and belief propagation. On a representative ITBench diagnostics task it improves both accuracy and run-to-run consistency over ReAct baselines.

items.title: Reliability by design: quantifying and eliminating fabrication risk in LLMs. From generative to consultative AI: a comparative analysis in the legal domain and lessons for high-stakes knowledge bases
items.title_zh: 设计即可靠：量化并消除大语言模型的捏造风险——从生成式到咨询式 AI 的法律领域比较分析及高风险知识库启示
items.summary: The study compares standalone generative models, basic RAG, and an end-to-end optimized RAG system on 2,700 judicial-style answers from 12 LLMs across 75 legal tasks under expert double-blind review. Standalone models show false citation rates above 30%, basic RAG reduces but does not eliminate misgrounding, and advanced RAG with embedding fine-tuning, reranking, and self-correction lowers fabrication below 0.2%.

items.title: Reliability by design: quantifying and eliminating fabrication risk in LLMs. From generative to consultative AI: a comparative analysis in the legal domain and lessons for high-stakes knowledge bases
items.title_zh: 设计即可靠：量化并消除大语言模型的捏造风险——从生成式到咨询式 AI 的法律领域比较分析及高风险知识库启示

items.title: A Hybrid Protocol for Large-Scale Semantic Dataset Generation in Low-Resource Languages: The Turkish Semantic Relations Corpus
items.title_zh: 低资源语言大规模语义数据集生成的混合协议：土耳其语语义关系语料库
items.summary: The authors describe a three-phase protocol that combines FastText embeddings with agglomerative clustering, Gemini 2.5-Flash classification, and curated dictionaries to build a Turkish semantic-relations corpus. The resulting 843,000 unique pairs across synonyms, antonyms, and co-hyponyms represent a tenfold scale increase at about $65, and downstream embedding and classification models reach 90% top-1 retrieval accuracy and 90% F1-macro.

items.title: Improving the Safety and Trustworthiness of Medical AI via Multi-Agent Evaluation Loops
items.title_zh: 通过多智能体评估循环提升医疗 AI 的安全性与可信度
items.summary: The framework pairs generative models DeepSeek R1 and Med-PaLM with evaluation agents LLaMA 3.1 and Phi-4, which score responses against AMA medical-ethics principles and a five-tier safety risk protocol across 900 clinical queries. It reports faster convergence for DeepSeek R1, an 89% reduction in ethical violations, and a 92% risk downgrade rate.

items.title: A model of errors in transformers
items.title_zh: Transformer 的错误模型
items.summary: The authors argue that incorrect deterministic outputs arise when small attention errors accumulate past a threshold, and derive a two-parameter relationship between task accuracy and complexity, interpreted as an elementary noise rate and a count of plausible erroneous tokens. Tests with Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and DeepSeek R1 show good agreement across tasks with some deviations, and the paper shows how prompt construction can reduce error rates.

items.title: ReSearch: A Multi-Stage Machine Learning Framework for Earth Science Data Discovery
items.title_zh: ReSearch：面向地球科学数据发现的多阶段机器学习框架
items.summary: ReSearch frames Earth Science data discovery as an iterative process of intent interpretation, high-recall retrieval, and context-aware ranking, combining lexical search, semantic embeddings, abbreviation expansion, and LLM reranking. On a literature-grounded benchmark it improves recall and ranking over baselines, especially for task-based queries that express abstract scientific goals.

items.title: Benchmarking LLMs for Pairwise Causal Discovery in Biomedical and Multi-Domain Contexts
items.title_zh: 在生物医学与多领域语境中对大语言模型进行成对因果发现基准测试
items.summary: The benchmark tests 13 open-source LLMs on pairwise causal discovery from text across 12 datasets, separating causal detection from extraction of cause and effect phrases under zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and few-shot prompting. The best detection score was 49.57% (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B) and the best extraction score 47.12% (Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct), with performance dropping on implicit, cross-sentence, and multi-pair relations.

items.title: MiRAGE: A Multiagent Framework for Generating Multimodal Multihop Question-Answer Dataset for RAG Evaluation
items.title_zh: MiRAGE：为 RAG 评估生成多模态多跳问答数据集的多智能体框架
items.summary: MiRAGE is a multi-agent framework that generates verified, domain-specific, multimodal, multi-hop question-answer datasets for RAG evaluation, using a recursive context-optimization loop, an adversarial verifier, and an expert-persona agent. Across regulations, finance, quantitative biology, and journalism it produces datasets with over 2.3 average hops and higher factual faithfulness, though visual grounding remains a frontier.

items.title: Grounding Large Language Models in Reaction Knowledge Graphs for Synthesis Retrieval
items.title_zh: 将大语言模型锚定于反应知识图谱以进行合成路线检索
items.summary: The authors cast reaction-path retrieval over a reaction knowledge graph as a Text2Cypher generation task and compare zero-shot prompting with one-shot variants using static, random and embedding-based exemplars. One-shot prompting with aligned exemplars performed best, while a checklist-driven self-correction loop mainly improved executability in zero-shot settings.

items.title: SPARC-RAG: Adaptive Sequential-Parallel Scaling with Context Management for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: SPARC-RAG：面向检索增强生成的自适应串行-并行扩展与上下文管理
items.summary: SPARC-RAG is a multi-agent RAG framework that coordinates sequential depth and parallel width under a shared context-management mechanism, generating complementary sub-queries and regulating when branches should exit. Across single- and multi-hop QA benchmarks it reports an average +6.2 F1 improvement over prior RAG baselines at lower inference cost.

items.title: Boosting Deep Reinforcement Learning with Semantic Knowledge for Robotic Manipulators
items.title_zh: 利用语义知识增强机器人机械臂的深度强化学习
items.summary: The paper integrates knowledge graph embeddings with visual observations to give a deep RL agent contextual information during training. In robotic manipulation experiments with fixed and randomized target attributes, it reports up to 60% less learning time and about a 15 percentage-point accuracy gain without extra training time or computational complexity.

items.title: Interpreting and Controlling Model Behavior via Constitutions for Atomic Concept Edits
items.title_zh: 通过原子概念编辑的宪法框架解释与控制模型行为
items.summary: The authors learn a natural-language constitution that maps atomic concept edits in prompts to predictable changes in model behavior, validated on mathematical reasoning and text-to-image alignment. They report an average 1.86x boost in success rate when using the learned constitutions for control, and find that GPT-Image emphasizes grammatical adherence while Imagen 4 prioritizes atmospheric coherence.

items.title: Lost in Translation: How Language Re-Aligns Vision for Cross-Species Pathology
items.title_zh: 语言如何重新对齐视觉：跨物种病理学的语义锚定
items.summary: The study fine-tunes CPath-CLIP for cross-cancer and cross-species pathology and finds that few-shot tuning improves same-cancer AUC from 64.9% to 72.6% and cross-cancer AUC from 56.84% to 66.31%, but cross-species transfer remains below the H-optimus-0 benchmark. Embedding analysis shows extremely high cosine similarity (above 0.99) between tumor and normal prototypes, and the proposed Semantic Anchoring uses language to provide a stable coordinate system for visual features.

items.title: HyperGraphPro: Progress-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structure-Guided Hypergraph RAG
items.title_zh: HyperGraphPro：面向结构引导超图 RAG 的进度感知强化学习
items.summary: HyperGraphPro is a hypergraph RAG framework that makes evidence-path progress the shared objective for retrieval and policy optimization, reranking hyperedges by query-conditioned structural distinctiveness. It adds stepwise progress-aware rewards based on coverage of answer-guided target hyperedges, and reports consistent multi-hop QA accuracy gains over existing GraphRAG methods.

items.title: Can LLMs Compress (and Decompress)? Evaluating Code Understanding and Execution via Invertibility
items.title_zh: 大语言模型会压缩（与解压）吗？通过可逆性评估代码理解与执行
items.summary: RoundTripCodeEval assesses code understanding through round-trip consistency across four lossless compression algorithms, using execution-free exact-match scoring of bijection fidelity. The authors report that models often pass forward and backward tasks separately yet fail the combined round trip, and that supervised fine-tuning and self-reflection saturate after one revision round without repairing fundamental misunderstandings.

items.title: OI-Bench: An Option Injection Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Susceptibility to Directive Interference
items.title_zh: OI-Bench：评估大语言模型受指令干扰程度的选项注入基准
items.summary: OI-Bench adds a misleading directive as an extra option to multiple-choice questions, creating 3,000 questions across knowledge, reasoning, and commonsense tasks with 16 directive types such as social compliance, bonus framing, threat framing, and instructional interference. Evaluating 12 LLMs reveals substantial and heterogeneous vulnerabilities, and the authors examine inference-time prompting and post-training alignment as mitigations.

items.title: Large Language Model-Powered Evolutionary Code Optimization on a Phylogenetic Tree
items.title_zh: 基于系统发育树的大语言模型进化式代码优化
items.summary: PhyloEvolve is an LLM-agent system that treats GPU-oriented code optimization as in-context reinforcement learning and uses a phylogenetic tree to track inheritance, divergence, and recombination among code variants.

items.title: Zero-shot adaptable task planning for autonomous construction robots: a comparative study of lightweight single and multi-AI agent systems
items.title_zh: 自主建筑机器人的零样本可适应任务规划：轻量单智能体与多智能体系统对比研究
items.summary: The study compares one single-agent and three multi-agent task-planning systems built from lightweight open-source LLMs and VLMs across painter, safety-inspector, and floor-tiling roles. The four-agent team outperformed GPT-4o on most metrics while being ten times more cost-effective, and three- and four-agent teams showed better generalizability.

items.title: Knowledge Graphs are Implicit Reward Models: Path-Derived Signals Enable Compositional Reasoning
items.title_zh: 知识图谱即隐式奖励模型：路径派生信号实现组合推理
items.summary: The authors use knowledge-graph paths as implicit reward models in a supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement-learning pipeline, rewarding models for composing intermediate axioms rather than only matching final answers. A 14B model trained on one-to-three-hop medical paths reportedly outperforms much larger models and systems including GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro on four-to-five-hop zero-shot queries, and proves robust to option-shuffling perturbations.

items.title: GLEAN: Grounded Lightweight Evaluation Anchors for Contamination-Aware Tabular Reasoning
items.title_zh: GLEAN：面向污染感知表格推理的轻量级评测锚点
items.summary: GLEAN is a lightweight evaluation protocol for small tabular models that combines contamination-aware probes, retrieval-reasoning diagnostics and structured L0–L4 error attribution under a 16GB GPU budget. Using Squall gold SQL as an executable anchor, it finds distinct error profiles for TAPEX and TAPAS and shows that retrieval Recall@K can saturate while end-to-end accuracy remains limited.

items.title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Under Constrained Communications
items.title_zh: 受限通信下的多智能体深度强化学习
items.summary: The paper proposes DG-MAPPO, a distributed multi-agent RL framework that removes centralized critics and global state information by using a distributed graph attention network for multi-hop communication. It reports better coordination than strong centralized-training baselines on StarCraft II, Google Research Football and Multi-Agent MuJoCo.

items.title: Beyond Factual QA: Mentorship-Oriented Question Answering over Long-Form Multilingual Content
items.title_zh: 超越事实问答：面向长视频多语言内容的导师式问答
items.summary: MentorQA is a multilingual benchmark of nearly 9,000 QA pairs drawn from 180 hours of long-form video in four languages, with evaluation dimensions for clarity, alignment and learning value beyond factual accuracy. Comparing single-agent, dual-agent, RAG and multi-agent architectures, the authors find multi-agent pipelines produce higher-quality mentorship responses, especially for complex topics and lower-resource languages.

items.title: Agentic Search in the Wild: Intents and Trajectory Dynamics from 14M+ Real Search Requests
items.title_zh: 野外智能体搜索：来自 1400 万次真实搜索请求的意图与轨迹动态
items.summary: The authors analyze 14.44 million search requests across 3.97 million sessions from DeepResearchGym, labeling session intents and query reformulations and proposing Context-driven Term Adoption Rate (CTAR) to measure whether new query terms trace back to retrieved evidence. They find over 90% of multi-turn sessions contain at most ten steps, fact-seeking sessions grow more repetitive, and on average 54% of newly introduced query terms appear in the accumulated evidence context.

items.title: Human-Aligned Enhancement of Programming Answers with LLMs Guided by User Feedback
items.title_zh: 基于用户反馈、由 LLM 引导的编程回答人类对齐增强
items.summary: The authors introduce ReSOlve, a benchmark of 790 Stack Overflow answers with comment threads annotated for improvement-related and general feedback, and AUTOCOMBAT, a tool that revises answers using comments and question context. AUTOCOMBAT produces near-human-quality improvements while preserving original intent, and 84.5% of 58 surveyed practitioners said they would adopt or recommend it.

items.title: Evaluating Semantic and Syntactic Understanding in Large Language Models for Payroll Systems
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型在薪资系统中的语义与句法理解
items.summary: The study uses a synthetic payroll system as a high-stakes test of whether LLMs can understand a schema, apply rules in the right order and produce cent-accurate results, across GPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Gemini model families. It identifies regimes where careful prompting is sufficient and regimes where explicit computation is required.

items.title: Spelling Bee Embeddings for Language Modeling
items.title_zh: 面向语言建模的拼写嵌入
items.summary: The authors modify the token embedding layer to infuse embeddings with spelling information, and scaling studies from 40M to 800M parameters suggest the gains are equivalent to needing about 8% less compute and data for the same test loss.

items.title: tech-leads-club/agent-skills
items.title_zh: tech-leads-club/agent-skills：面向专业 AI 编程智能体的经验证技能注册表
items.summary: agent-skills is a TypeScript-based registry of validated skills for professional AI coding agents, designed to extend tools including Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

items.title: WordPress/agent-skills
items.title_zh: WordPress/agent-skills：面向 AI 编程助手的 WordPress 技能
items.summary: WordPress/agent-skills is a JavaScript repository that packages WordPress knowledge for AI coding assistants, covering blocks, themes, plugins, and best practices.

items.title: AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill
items.title_zh: AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill：为 AI 编程工具提供 SwiftUI 最佳实践
items.summary: SwiftUI-Agent-Skill adds expert SwiftUI best-practice guidance to AI coding tools through the open Agent Skills format.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.title_zh: last30days-skill：跨平台调研的 AI 智能体技能
items.summary: last30days-skill is a Python agent skill that researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary.

items.title: alchaincyf/huashu-skills
items.title_zh: huashu-skills：花叔开源的 Agent Skills 总目录
items.summary: huashu-skills is an open-source catalog of 52 Agent Skills from Huashu, organized into 16 flagship, 14 persona-based and 22 built-in skills, with tiered categories, an AI-agent install protocol, a machine-readable skills.json and update checks.

items.title: endee-io/endee
items.title_zh: endee：单节点支持 10 亿向量的高性能向量数据库
items.summary: endee is a high-performance vector database designed to handle up to 1 billion vectors on a single node through optimized indexing and execution, and is also offered in the cloud and under an enterprise license with a 30-day evaluation.

items.title: qufei1993/skills-hub
items.title_zh: skills-hub：统一管理与同步 Agent Skills 的跨平台桌面应用
items.summary: skills-hub is a cross-platform desktop app written in Rust that manages Agent Skills in one place and syncs them to the global skills directories of multiple AI coding tools.

items.title: Jan 22, 2026 Product Announcing New LlamaParse SDKs and Parse API v2 Read
items.title_zh: LlamaIndex 发布全新 LlamaParse SDK 与 Parse API v2
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced new LlamaParse SDKs and a Parse API v2 in a short product post; the available excerpt offers no further technical detail.

items.title: Unrolling the Codex agent loop
items.title_zh: 拆解 Codex 智能体循环
items.summary: OpenAI published a technical deep dive into the Codex agent loop, describing how Codex CLI orchestrates models, tools and prompts through the Responses API.

items.title: The Agentic AI Handbook: Production-Ready Patterns
items.title_zh: 《Agentic AI 手册》：生产级模式
items.summary: The Agentic AI Handbook is a guide offering 113 production-informed patterns for building reliable AI agents.

items.title: Real-Time Trend Prediction via Continually-Aligned LLM Query Generation
items.title_zh: 通过持续对齐的 LLM 查询生成实现实时趋势预测
items.summary: RTTP generates search-style queries directly from news content with a continually learning LLM and scores them by engagement strength and creator authority, aiming to surface trends before search volume forms. Deployed at production scale on Facebook and Meta AI products, it reports a 91.4% improvement in tail-trend detection precision@500 and 19% higher query-generation accuracy, while Mix-Policy DPO mitigates catastrophic forgetting during updates.
